name: Jais 13B
notes: Arabic-centric bilingual (Arabic-English) large language model with 13B parameters. Trained on a large Arabic-English corpus, achieving SoTA on Arabic benchmarks.

name: Jais 30B Chat
notes: Chat-tuned version of the Jais Arabic-English bilingual LLM. Supports multi-turn conversations in Arabic and English.

name: AceGPT 13B Chat
notes: Arabic-focused LLM based on LLaMA, fine-tuned with Arabic instruction data and RLHF for Arabic cultural alignment.

name: ALLaM (Arabic Large Language Model)
notes: Saudi Data and AI Authority's Arabic-first large language model for Arabic language understanding and generation tasks.

name: Whisper Large V3 (Arabic fine-tuned)
notes: OpenAI's Whisper large v3 with strong Arabic ASR capabilities. Community fine-tunes available for dialectal Arabic.

name: MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech) — Arabic
notes: Meta's Massively Multilingual Speech model covering 1100+ languages including Arabic dialects. Supports ASR and TTS.

name: CAMeL Tools
notes: Suite of Arabic NLP tools including morphological analysis, dialect identification, NER, and sentiment analysis. Built on CAMeLBERT.

name: FARASA Arabic NLP Toolkit
notes: Fast and accurate Arabic NLP toolkit by QCRI. Includes segmentation, POS tagging, NER, and diacritization.

name: Stanza Arabic Models
notes: Stanford Stanza's Arabic models for tokenization, POS tagging, lemmatization, dependency parsing, and NER.

name: AraBERT v2
notes: Pre-trained Arabic BERT model. Effective for downstream Arabic NLP tasks: NER, sentiment analysis, and question answering.

name: AraGPT2
notes: Arabic GPT-2 model for natural language generation in Modern Standard Arabic and dialectal variants.

name: Arabic Speech Corpus
notes: High-quality Arabic speech corpus for ASR research. Contains recordings in Modern Standard Arabic.

name: HARD — Hotel Arabic Reviews Dataset
notes: Arabic hotel review dataset for sentiment analysis. Contains 93K reviews with positive/negative labels.

name: ARCD — Arabic Reading Comprehension Dataset
notes: Arabic QA dataset modeled after SQuAD. Contains 1,395 questions on Arabic Wikipedia articles.

name: LABR — Large-scale Arabic Book Reviews
notes: Arabic book review dataset with 63K reviews. 5-star rating scale for sentiment analysis.

name: WikiANN — Arabic NER
notes: Cross-lingual NER dataset with Arabic split. Wikipedia-based NER tags for PER, LOC, ORG.

name: Calliar — Algerian Arabic Dialect Corpus
notes: Handwriting recognition dataset for Algerian Arabic dialect, useful for OCR and dialectal Arabic processing.

name: NADI — Nuanced Arabic Dialect Identification
notes: Arabic dialect identification dataset covering 21 Arab countries. Includes Algerian, Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and Maghrebi dialects.
